title: Theorem 2: generalized (delta,gamma)-Kakeya lower bound
statement_scope: Whole theorem at lines 179-184: let F be a finite field with q elements and let K subset F^n be a (δ,γ)-Kakeya Set. Then |K| ≥ binom(d+n-1,n-1), where d = floor(q · min{δ,γ}) - 2. The counted statement includes the definition's auxiliary set L subset F^n with |L| ≥ δ q^n and, for every x in L, a line in direction x meeting K in at least γ q points. The proof's zero-vector and nonzero-vector branches and the exact author d formula are retained without adding assumptions or repairing the author.
